sets.relationshipLabel: a category of camp gear and one specific kind of it
sets.explanation: A tool and a vehicle are both broad categories, and a pickaxe and a sled are specific items that belong to each.

sets.relationshipLabel: a tool and the motion it exists to perform
sets.explanation: A pan exists to sift and a sluice exists to wash — each tool is defined by the single motion it was built to do.

sets.relationshipLabel: the start and end of one continuous span
sets.explanation: A freeze ends in a thaw just as a stampede of miners ends in a ghost town — each pair bookends the same rise-and-fall arc at a different scale.

sets.relationshipLabel: the small thing that necessarily enables the larger thing
sets.explanation: A match is what makes a campfire possible and a lantern is what makes visibility possible — each small object is the necessary cause of the larger condition.
